<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#241322"><title>Tiny: Left Unsupervised | Stage 4: Visible HIT LINE Trial</title><style>
:root{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-synthesis:none;color:#ffeacd;background:#080811}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0912;touch-action:manipulation}body{display:grid;place-items:center}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #aff4f5;outline-offset:1px}
#game{position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:min(100vw,177.77778dvh);height:min(100dvh,56.25vw);aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;border:clamp(2px,.4vw,6px) solid #b98565;border-radius:clamp(8px,1.7vw,23px);background:#2f1c34;box-shadow:0 0 32px #000c}
#game:after{content:"";inset:0;position:absolute;border:1px solid #ffe4a15c;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:70}
#hud{position:absolute;z-index:40;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:10.5%;display:flex;gap:.75%;align-items:center;padding:0 1%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#231027f5,#34203cee);border-bottom:2px solid #dbb180;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
#brand{font:900 clamp(10px,1.4vw,22px) Georgia,serif;color:#ffcb8b;margin-right:.6%}.pill{border:2px solid #b88a9d99;border-radius:25px;padding:.25% .6%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vw,18px);background:#321b36e6}
#hud .small{font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vw,18px)}#hud .fillspace{flex:1}#energyTrack{width:10%;height:18%;min-width:35px;background:#1b1127;border:1px solid #ffb7d0;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}
#energyFill{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e86bb1,#ffdfb3);width:35%}.hudBtn{border:2px solid #9d789f;background:#38233f;color:#fff1d5;border-radius:13px;width:4.1%;height:81%;min-width:26px;font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vw,27px);padding:0;line-height:1}
#scene{position:absolute;top:10.5%;left:0;right:0;bottom:28%;background:linear-gradient(#1e122216,#260f180e),url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/100% 100% no-repeat;overflow:hidden}
#scene.shake{animation:shake .35s linear}#scene.hot{box-shadow:inset 0 0 65px #ff283685}
#scene .windowShine{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 34%,#fff2 0,transparent 64%)}
#tinyHero,#deviHero{position:absolute;z-index:9;bottom:6%;height:75%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 7px #2c131aba);pointer-events:none}
#tinyHero{left:0;width:22%;object-position:left bottom}#deviHero{right:-.5%;width:22%;height:83%;object-position:right bottom}
#scene.running #tinyHero{height:65%;width:18%;bottom:3%}#scene.running #deviHero{height:69%;width:18%;bottom:3%}
#scene.bonk #tinyHero{animation:bonked .42s ease-in-out}
#speech{position:absolute;z-index:18;top:5%;left:28%;width:44%;min-height:15%;padding:.75% 1.7%;border:3px solid #63384e;border-radius:18px;background:#fff9e9;color:#40253e;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(9px,1.18vw,19px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.2;box-shadow:0 7px 0 #4825447d;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#speech b{display:block;color:#9b4a6d;font-size:.86em}#speech.hidden{display:none}#speech.radio{left:30%;width:40%;top:3%;min-height:0;background:#271a36e8;color:#fff2cf;border-color:#d6b07f;font-size:clamp(9px,1.08vw,17px);padding:.5% 1.2%;box-shadow:0 4px 8px #0006}#speech.radio b{color:#ffaacb}
#sectionTitle{position:absolute;z-index:16;top:2.5%;left:1.2%;max-width:36%;background:#32192edb;border:2px solid #dfb271;border-radius:22px;font:900 clamp(9px,1.2vw,18px) Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #0005;padding:.55% 1.1%;color:#ffe6b0}
#trackLines{position:absolute;inset:12% 19% 15%;pointer-events:none;z-index:4}
.track-guide{position:absolute;bottom:-2%;height:76%;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;opacity:.18;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#84f5b300 0%,#81dfc411 65%,#97ffb893 100%);transform-origin:50% 100%;clip-path:polygon(42% 0%,58% 0%,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.track-guide:nth-child(1){left:5%;width:30%}.track-guide:nth-child(2){left:35%;width:30%}.track-guide:nth-child(3){left:65%;width:30%}
#oncoming{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;pointer-events:none}.obstacle{position:absolute;transform-origin:center bottom;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 3px #3b2127a8);will-change:transform,top,left;transition:opacity .1s}
.obstacle .shape{position:relative;display:block;font-size:clamp(21px,3.7vw,58px);line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 2px #200e20)}.obstacle .tag{display:block;margin-top:3px;padding:2px 6px;background:#351d32ed;border:2px solid #ffcf91;border-radius:9px;color:#fff8d6;font-size:clamp(8px,.82vw,15px);font-weight:950}.obstacle.overhead .shape{font-size:clamp(28px,4.1vw,65px)}.obstacle.overhead .tag{background:#a53c56}
#nearWarning{position:absolute;z-index:21;top:19%;left:28%;width:44%;text-align:center;color:#fffbe6;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #201121;font-size:clamp(10px,1.23vw,19px);font-weight:950;background:#341a2eeb;border:2px solid #ffcf97;border-radius:15px;padding:.5% 1%;display:none}
#nearWarning.duck{border-color:#ffd773;background:#883c40ef}
#trackLabels{position:absolute;z-index:23;left:26%;right:26%;bottom:17%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1%}
.trackLabel{font-size:clamp(8px,1vw,16px);padding:.5% 0;border:2px solid #e6c697;border-radius:20px;text-align:center;color:#eaf8f1;background:#204a3edc;font-weight:950;text-shadow:0 1px 1px #12252b}
.trackLabel.danger{background:#7f2b3adf;color:#ffe8e5;border-color:#fe92a3}.trackLabel.chosen{outline:3px solid #fcf4a7;box-shadow:0 0 13px #ffe394}
#dash{position:absolute;z-index:23;left:24%;right:24%;bottom:1%;height:15%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2%;padding:1% 1.8%;background:#241729ef;border:2px solid #e8b97e;border-radius:16px}
#pressureArea{flex:1;min-width:0}#pressureHead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,16px);font-weight:950;gap:4px}
#pressureTrack,#brakeTrack{height:clamp(7px,1.15vw,17px);border-radius:18px;background:#140c1f;border:2px solid #e7be84;overflow:hidden}
#pressureFill,#brakeFill{height:100%;width:35%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#52d6a1,#ffbb49);transition:width .1s}#pressureFill.hot{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffbb50,#f14959)}
#vent{border:2px solid #ffe2a5;background:linear-gradient(#f9d783,#b46b2d);border-radius:13px;color:#4a2437;font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,17px);font-weight:950;height:100%;padding:0 3%}#vent:disabled{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.5}
#boardFlash{position:absolute;z-index:28;pointer-events:none;left:35%;top:41%;width:30%;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(13px,2.2vw,31px);color:#ffefac;font-weight:1000;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #16092e,0 0 8px #fdaf6d;display:none}
#topCounter{position:absolute;z-index:18;top:2.5%;right:1.3%;font-size:clamp(9px,1vw,15px);background:#25172be6;padding:.5% 1%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #f3cc83}
#feedback{position:absolute;z-index:30;bottom:22%;left:24%;width:52%;height:10%;background:#391a3ad9;border:2px solid #edb36e;border-radius:16px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(10px,1.5vw,23px);font-weight:950;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #150b23}
#feedback.show{display:flex}#feedback.good{background:#245c4ad9}#feedback.bad{background:#8e344bdc}
#scene.crisis #nearWarning,#scene.crisis #trackLabels{display:none!important}
#panicCard{position:absolute;z-index:33;top:24%;left:30%;width:40%;background:#311b39f3;border:3px solid #ffca82;border-radius:18px;text-align:center;padding:2%;display:none;color:#fff7e7;box-shadow:0 7px 19px #070211a9}
#panicCard.show{display:block}#panicCard h2{font-size:clamp(15px,2.2vw,32px);margin:0;color:#ffd5ab}#panicCard p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.1vw,18px);margin:2% 0}#panicSeconds{font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,43px);font-weight:950;color:#ff9dbf}
#bottom{position:absolute;z-index:41;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:28%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:35% 44% 21%;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(#2d1934,#180f29);border-top:4px solid #d8ab7b;padding:1% 1.2%;gap:1%}
#narration{align-self:center;min-width:0}#kicker{color:#f6b3d7;font-size:clamp(8px,.9vw,14px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.03em}#speaker{font:900 clamp(13px,2.2vw,33px) Georgia,serif;color:#ffd18d;margin:.2% 0}#message{font-size:clamp(9px,1.05vw,17px);line-height:1.25;max-height:58px;overflow:hidden}
#controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1.2%;flex-wrap:wrap;height:100%;min-width:0}
.action{border:3px solid #fff1c0;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8d18d,#c27f3e);font-weight:1000;color:#4a2340;min-height:40%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,17px);padding:.8% 3%;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #562948af;touch-action:manipulation}
.action.secondary{background:linear-gradient(#f06ca0,#a82f70);color:#fff8ef;border-color:#ffd0a5}
#controls.driving .action{flex:1;min-width:20%;padding:.8% .5%;height:47%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.18vw,18px)}.action.selected{border-color:#aeffe0;box-shadow:0 0 14px #a5ffb7;background:linear-gradient(#96ebc6,#31a687)}.action:disabled{filter:grayscale(.7);opacity:.65}
#brakePanel{display:none;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5%;height:100%;min-width:0;padding:1%}
#brakeBtn{height:48%;border:2px solid #ffda9f;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(#df5d7f,#a83058);font-weight:1000;color:#fff7df;font-size:clamp(8px,1vw,17px);touch-action:none;user-select:none}
#brakeBtn.pressed{background:linear-gradient(#86dbc0,#298e76)}#brakePanel small{font-size:clamp(9px,.95vw,16px);font-weight:950;text-align:center}
#overlay{position:absolute;z-index:62;inset:0;background:#150c22e8;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:5%;color:#fff0d7}#overlay.show{display:flex}#overlayBox{position:relative;max-width:600px;width:80%;background:linear-gradient(#55314b,#291b3b);border:3px solid #f7c57d;border-radius:22px;padding:5%;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0008}#overlayBox h2{color:#ffe6af;margin:0 0 3%;font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,30px)}#overlayBox p{font-size:clamp(11px,1.25vw,19px);line-height:1.45}#overlayBox .action{margin:2%}#guideClose{position:absolute;top:6px;right:9px;background:#3e253c;color:#fff3d9;border:2px solid #caa57d;border-radius:50%;height:32px;width:32px}
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:45;right:2%;top:13%;background:#371c3fe8;color:#fff3d6;border:2px solid #f3be83;border-radius:9px;padding:1%;font-size:clamp(9px,1vw,16px);font-weight:850;display:none;max-width:24%;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes bonked{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}20%{transform:rotate(-9deg)}40%{transform:rotate(10deg)}65%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}}@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-5px)}40%{transform:translateX(5px)}65%{transform:translateX(-3px)}}
@media(max-width:820px){#hud{gap:.55%}#brand{max-width:30%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}#scene.running #tinyHero{width:18%;height:61%}#scene.running #deviHero{width:18%;height:65%}#scene{bottom:28%}#narration #message{max-height:35px}#speech{top:6%;max-height:32%;overflow:hidden}#topCounter{right:1%;top:3%}#trackLabels{left:25%;right:25%}}
@media(max-height:440px) and (orientation:landscape){#narration #message{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden}#scene.running #tinyHero{height:59%}#scene.running #deviHero{height:65%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:0s!important;transition-duration:0s!important}}

/* FAIR-STAGGER REVISION: full-width overheads are never lane objects. */
#overheadBeam{position:absolute;z-index:29;display:none;left:17%;right:17%;top:29%;height:clamp(22px,4.2vw,54px);pointer-events:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3%;border:3px solid #ffe5a4;border-radius:11px;color:#fff8d9;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #3b152c;background:repeating-linear-gradient(120deg,#60293feF 0 24px,#f6bc6077 24px 36px,#60293fEF 36px 60px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #271028a0,0 0 15px #ffb86660;opacity:.93;white-space:nowrap}
#overheadBeam strong{font-size:clamp(10px,1.3vw,20px);max-width:80%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#overheadBeam .overheadChevron{font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vw,26px);font-weight:900}
#overheadBeam.imminent{background:repeating-linear-gradient(120deg,#9c213b 0 24px,#ffa947 24px 36px,#9c213b 36px 60px);box-shadow:0 0 24px #ff654c;animation:overheadPulse .5s infinite alternate}
#nearWarning{top:12%;left:31%;width:38%;z-index:30}
#scene.crisis #overheadBeam{display:none!important}
@keyframes overheadPulse{to{filter:brightness(1.33)}}
@media(max-width:820px){#overheadBeam{left:18%;right:18%;height:clamp(20px,3.8vw,38px)}#overheadBeam strong{font-size:clamp(9px,1.25vw,14px)}#nearWarning{top:13%;left:30%;width:40%}}


/* Collision marker is fixed precisely at where lane hazards hit: renderObstacle y=32+progress*42 => 74% at progress 1. */
#collisionLine{display:none;position:absolute;z-index:24;left:26%;right:26%;top:74%;height:4px;pointer-events:none;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffdf89);transform:translateY(-1px)}
#scene.running #collisionLine{display:grid}
#collisionLine .impactSegment{border-top:4px dashed #ffd77a;height:3px;transition:border-color .15s,filter .15s}
#collisionLine .impactSegment.safe{border-top:4px solid #86ffb5;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #3effa5)}
#collisionLine .impactSegment.danger{border-top:4px solid #ff7b81;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #ff3f6f)}
#collisionLine .impactSegment.chosen{box-shadow:0 4px 0 #fff4ca;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #fff09d)}
#collisionLine.duck .impactSegment{border-color:#ffbf5e;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ff5b70)}
#collisionLine .impactLabel{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:7px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(8px,.85vw,13px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#2b1426;font-weight:1000;background:#ffe59a;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 7px;box-shadow:0 1px 7px #170d25a8}
#collisionLine.duck .impactLabel{background:#ff8e8c;color:#2d0e21}
#nearWarning{line-height:1.15;min-height:0;white-space:normal;padding:5px 8px}
#nearWarning strong{display:block;font-size:1em;line-height:1.12}
#nearWarning small{display:block;font-size:.83em;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.14;color:#ffeaca;font-weight:800}
#scene.crisis #collisionLine{display:none!important}
@media(max-height:440px) and (orientation:landscape){#collisionLine .impactLabel{font-size:8px;bottom:5px;padding:2px 4px}#collisionLine .impactSegment{border-top-width:3px}#nearWarning{top:12%;font-size:clamp(9px,1vw,12px);padding:3px 6px}}

</style></head><body><main id="game" aria-label="Tiny Left Unsupervised Stage 4 illustrated train game">
<header id="hud"><span id="brand">🎀 TINY LEFT UNSUPERVISED</span><span class="pill">STAGE 4</span><span class="pill" id="chaos">CHAOS 0</span><span id="energy" class="small">⚡ 35/100</span><div id="energyTrack"><i id="energyFill"></i></div><span class="fillspace"></span><button class="hudBtn" id="helpBtn" aria-label="Instructions">?</button><button class="hudBtn" id="pauseBtn" aria-label="Pause">⏸</button><button class="hudBtn" id="soundBtn" aria-label="Toggle sound">♫</button><button class="hudBtn" id="fullBtn" aria-label="Fullscreen">⛶</button></header>
<section id="scene"><div class="windowShine"></div><div id="trackLines"><div class="track-guide"></div><div class="track-guide"></div><div class="track-guide"></div></div>
<div id="collisionLine" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true"><span class="impactSegment"></span><span class="impactSegment"></span><span class="impactSegment"></span><span class="impactLabel">HIT LINE • SWITCH BEFORE THIS</span></div>
<div id="sectionTitle">🚂 THE CHAOS EXPRESS</div><div id="topCounter">NEXT DISASTER: 0 / 24</div><div id="oncoming" aria-live="off"></div><div id="overheadBeam" aria-live="off"><span class="overheadChevron">⬇</span><strong id="overheadText">DUCK</strong><span class="overheadChevron">⬇</span></div><div id="nearWarning"></div>
<img id="tinyHero" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Tiny in her black ruffled skirt and bow"><img id="deviHero" src="data:image/webp;base64,
